content: {"like": ["The Blu‑ray includes the UV code and the original 2010 movie.", "The film is very funny with a lot of good comedy.", "The story feels modern and entertaining, especially the road‑trip plotline.", "There is humor that appeals to adults, such as the reference to Psycho.", "The performance of the New Wimp (Jason Drucker) is praised for timing, facial expressions, and physical acting.", "The New Rodrick (Charlie Wright) is noted for a solid portrayal of a low‑IQ clueless older brother.", "Overall acting and direction are described as solid and enjoyable."], "dislike": ["The parents in the film are not special and the original parents are missing, which the reviewer wishes had been included.", "Rowley appears only in one or two scenes, limiting his contribution.", "The casting of the New Rodrick caused controversy among fans because he does not resemble the original actor.", "Fans were upset that Zachary Gordon did not reprise his role as the Wimpy Kid, despite his age and changes in appearance."]}
